title: EventBus cross-callback unregister during delivery contract

contract.cross_callback_unregister: A callback can unregister another callback during active event delivery
contract.current_delivery_isolation: Unregistering another callback does not interrupt the already-active delivery chain
contract.current_delivery_snapshot: The target callback still receives the event already being delivered
contract.registry_update: The target callback is removed from the listener registry after the mutation
contract.future_delivery_absence: The removed callback does not receive subsequent events
contract.remaining_callback_preservation: Other callbacks remain registered and continue receiving events
contract.repeated_unregister: Unregistering an already removed callback returns false
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after cross-callback mutation
contract.registry_stability: Cross-callback unregister does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus operations require the events permission
